observations: Two tall vertical stainless steel cylinders stand side by side on a concrete plinth.
A black plastic water tank sits behind the cylinders with partial lettering visible.
Green PVC pipes and fittings connect the cylinders in a framed manifold system.
Valves and unions are visible on the pipework at multiple heights.
Watermark text reads MACO MACHINES POSTED ON JIJI across the images.
No brand plate or model number is readable on the cylinders themselves.

claims.claim: Available in 16 inches, 20 inches and 24 inches
claims.evidence: Photos show cylinders but no measuring tape or scale to confirm diameters.
Welded appearance is consistent with local fabrication but cannot be proven remotely.
Photos 0-2 show vertical cylindrical tanks with inlet/outlet pipework arranged for treatment.

risks.risk: Cylinders may be empty shells that do not actually treat water
risks.proof: Video of water flowing through the system with before/after quality demonstration

risks.risk: Tanks or pipe joints may leak
risks.proof: Video of the system filled and pressurized with water

risks.risk: Actual cylinder diameters may not match the claimed 16, 20 and 24 inches
risks.proof: Measuring tape shot across the top opening of each cylinder

risks.risk: Black storage tank behind the cylinders may be cracked or damaged
risks.proof: Close-up inspection of the black tank

proof_requests: Video of the treatment system running with water through both cylinders
Measuring tape shot across the top opening of each cylinder to confirm sizes
Close-up photos of any nameplate or brand marking on the cylinders
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as a water treatment cylinder tank system; no model number is required for plain goods, and it can be priced at its worst case as untested or not working.
